verdict.rationale: Statsig's official MCP server lets AI clients such as Claude Code and Cursor "explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI." The Console API exposes console actions programmatically, and experiments report metric lifts with confidence intervals, which together support an agent reading experiment configs and outcomes. missing for 10: explicit documentation that experiment results/scorecard metrics (lifts, significance) are retrievable via the Console API or MCP tools, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent summarizing results and recommending ship/rollback.
